title: Shooting star
doc: A single shooting star streaks across the night sky.

title: Aurora
doc: Rare northern lights ripple green and violet low over the mountain on a dark night.

title: UFO
doc: A flying saucer glides in at night, hovers, beams a salmon up out of the river, and zips away.

title: Sasquatch
doc: Sasquatch strolls along the far shore and stops to wave; after dark only its red eyes show.

title: Leaping salmon
doc: A salmon leaps clear of the river and splashes back in.

title: Sternwheeler
doc: The Columbia Gorge sternwheeler paddles past, red paddlewheel turning.

title: Rainbow
doc: A rainbow arcs across the sky opposite the afternoon sun.

title: Sky whale
doc: A whale swims slowly across the sky, spouting from its blowhole now and then.

title: Steaming summit
doc: Mt. Hood lets off a lazy plume of steam from near the summit.

title: Dangling spider
doc: A spider drops down on its thread, dangles a while, and climbs back up.

title: Mega jump
doc: A kiteboarder boosts a huge jump, right off the top of the screen.

title: Shark
doc: A dorsal fin cruises upriver toward a windsurfer; the jaws come up and the sailor is gone.

title: Humpback breach
doc: A humpback swims upriver: spouts as it surfaces, one breach with a big splash, flukes on the dive.

title: Sea lion
doc: A sea lion pops up, barks, lunges after a leaping salmon and slips back under.

title: Geese in a V
doc: A honking V of Canada geese crossing the sky, in the migration seasons.

title: Great blue heron
doc: A great blue heron flaps low along the shore, lands on the sandbar, fishes, and flies off.

title: Paragliders
doc: Colourful paraglider canopies drifting down off the western ridge toward the waterfront.

title: Sturgeon
doc: A giant white sturgeon's bony back breaks the surface, rolls, and sinks. Very rare.

title: Steam train
doc: The Mt. Hood Railroad's steam excursion puffing along the shoreline tracks.

title: Lewis & Clark canoes
doc: Lewis and Clark's dugout canoes paddling downriver -- October only, as in 1805.

title: Tall ship
doc: A tall ship sails by beyond the bridge.

title: Fireworks
doc: Fireworks over the river on the Fourth of July and at midnight on New Year's Eve.

title: Halloween
doc: Halloween night: a witch on her broom crosses the moon and jack-o'-lanterns glow in town windows.

title: Christmas Eve
doc: Christmas Eve: Santa's sleigh and reindeer fly across the moon.

title: Holiday lights
doc: Strings of coloured lights along the bridge on December nights (town view).

title: Harvest moon
doc: On the full moon nearest the autumn equinox, the moon rises huge and orange over the east hills.

title: Satellites
doc: A train of satellites -- a line of moving dots -- crossing the night sky.

title: Hydroplanes
doc: Two unlimited hydroplanes race down the river throwing huge roostertails.

title: Giant spider
doc: A giant jumping spider peeks up over the bottom edge, looks around with its big front eyes, and ducks.

title: Windsurfer catapult
doc: A windsurfer gets launched over the front of the board, splashes down and uphauls the sail.

title: Kite crash
doc: A kite loops, nose-dives into the water, sits there a moment, and relaunches.

title: Pear blossom
doc: Pear-blossom time: the orchard slopes behind town turn white and pink (April).

title: Fall color
doc: October: gold, orange and red patches through the orchards, the west ridge and the bluff.

title: Bats at dusk
doc: A flutter of little bats over the waterfront just after summer sunsets.

title: Elk herd
doc: A small elk herd grazing slowly along the orchard slope above town.

title: Salmon run
doc: The September salmon run: a burst of leaps all across the river.

title: Colossal Claude
doc: The Columbia's own sea serpent legend: humps, a long neck, a look around, and gone.

title: Kraken
doc: Very rare: tentacles rise around the barge, curl, and slip back under.

title: Rubber duck race
doc: A charity-race flotilla of yellow rubber ducks bobbing downriver.

title: Message in a bottle
doc: A message in a bottle drifting down the river, glinting.

title: Space station pass
doc: The real International Space Station crossing the sky on actual visible passes over Hood River.

title: Green flash
doc: On a clear evening, a brief green flash on the sun's last sliver as it slips behind the ridge.

title: Lunar eclipse
doc: A real lunar eclipse: Earth's shadow creeps across the moon and turns it copper.

title: Valentine's Day
doc: Valentine's Day: little hearts drifting up from the town's windows.

title: St. Patrick's Day
doc: St. Patrick's Day: a rainbow that ends in a pot of gold on the sandbar.

title: Easter bunny
doc: Easter Sunday: a bunny hops along the waterfront leaving pastel eggs behind.

title: Thanksgiving turkey
doc: Thanksgiving: a turkey strutting along the waterfront, gobbling.

title: Birthday
doc: A birthday banner with a cake and candles.

title: 11:11 wish star
doc: At 11:11 and 12:34 (am and pm) a bright shooting star crosses -- day or night.

title: Lenticular cap
doc: A lenticular cap cloud parked on Mt. Hood's summit -- a windy, moist-aloft day's flying saucer.

title: Alpenglow
doc: Just after sunset the mountain flushes pink while the valley is already in shadow.

title: Pear truck
doc: Harvest time on the Fruit Loop: a pickup piled with pear bins heads along the freeway.

title: County fair
doc: Late July: the Hood River County Fair's Ferris wheel turning, lit up on the hillside.

title: Windsurf race
doc: A windsurfing race: a pack of sails rounds the marks while the committee boat's horn sounds.

title: Ice floes
doc: A hard freeze: ice floes drift downriver, and a bald eagle rides one.

title: Spill-mist rainbow
doc: Spring runoff: spill mist rising far downriver, with a small rainbow in it.

title: Lost paddleboarder
doc: In a gale, a stand-up paddleboarder paddles furiously upriver and drifts helplessly downriver.

title: Beaver
doc: A beaver swims for the sandbar towing a stick, then slaps its tail.

title: Snow day
doc: A snow day: kids sledding down the hillside above town and trudging back up.

title: Meteor shower
doc: Real meteor showers on their peak nights, streaking away from the true radiant.

title: Planets
doc: Venus, Jupiter, Mars (when it's close) and Saturn where they really are.

title: Starlink train
doc: A freshly launched Starlink 'string of pearls' crossing the sky -- the real one, when it's visible.

title: Solar eclipse
doc: A real solar eclipse over Hood River: the moon takes a bite out of the sun (next one: Jan 14, 2029).

title: Comet
doc: A naked-eye comet, from real orbits, when one is bright and up; a demo one when forced.

title: Noctilucent clouds
doc: Midsummer twilight: electric-blue night-shining clouds low in the northwest (the right-hand edge).

title: Bigfoot windsurfing
doc: Sasquatch, on a windsurfer, flying across the river. Waves on the way past.

title: Giant cat
doc: A giant tabby rises from behind the bluff, watches a kite, and bats it out of the sky.

title: Spider clock
doc: The original spider clock's jumping spider returns: it hops along the clock, bumping each digit.

title: Balloon festival
doc: A calm dawn: a dozen hot air balloons drifting up the Gorge, burners flaring.

title: Osprey dive, left
doc: The osprey crosses the whole scene and dives just past the bridge.

title: Osprey dive, right
doc: The osprey glides in, folds, and stoops into the river right of centre.

title: Eagle steals the fish
doc: A bald eagle overtakes the osprey on its climb and snatches the fish.

title: Tall ship, bridge lift
doc: The tall ship sails in close, too tall for the bridge, and the lift span rises to let it through.

title: Train of Lights
doc: The Mt. Hood Railroad's Train of Lights: an excursion train strung with holiday lights, on December nights.

title: White pelicans
doc: American white pelicans circling high on a summer thermal, flashing white and black as they turn.

title: Floatplane
doc: A floatplane comes in low, lands on the river, taxis, and takes off again.

title: Drift boat angler
doc: An angler in a drift boat hooks something enormous and gets towed upriver. A sturgeon, of course.

title: Loose kite
doc: A kiter lets go: the kite sails off over town, tumbling, lines trailing.

title: Log raft
doc: A tug pushes a long raft of logs slowly downriver.

title: SUP dog
doc: A paddleboarder out for a cruise, with the dog riding up front, tail going.

title: Duck family
doc: A mother duck leads her ducklings across the river; a windsurfer has to swerve around them.

title: Snowman
doc: After a real snowfall someone builds a snowman on the sandbar: carrot nose, stick arms, a hat.

title: Paper airplane
doc: A paper airplane loops across the scene and lands on top of the clock.

title: Moonbow
doc: A moonbow: a pale white rainbow opposite a bright moon on a misty night. Rare and real.

title: Sun dogs
doc: Sun dogs: bright spots either side of a low winter sun, on a cold day with a thin icy haze.

title: Moon and planet
doc: When the moon passes close to Venus, Jupiter, Mars or Saturn, the pair gets a label.

title: Sunset contrails
doc: Jet contrails lit pink and gold high overhead just after sunset.

title: God rays
doc: Crepuscular rays: beams of light fanning down through breaking clouds in the late afternoon.

title: Summit climbers
doc: Climbing season on Mt. Hood: a string of headlamps creeping up the mountain before dawn.

title: New Year's countdown
doc: New Year's Eve: the last ten seconds counted down big in the sky, then fireworks.

title: Pi Day clock
doc: Pi Day: at 3:14 on March 14 the clock briefly reads 3.14159.

title: Friday the 13th cat
doc: Friday the 13th: a black cat strolls along the waterfront, stops, and looks right at you.

title: April Fools' mirror
doc: April Fools' Day: for one minute the whole scene is mirrored. The clock stays put.

title: Moon landing day
doc: July 20: a tiny lunar lander and flag sit on the moon, marking the 1969 landing.

title: Groundhog Day
doc: Groundhog Day: a groundhog pops up on the sandbar. Sees its shadow in sun, and it's six more weeks.

title: Mt. Hood burps
doc: Very rare: Mt. Hood burps. A small, cheerful puff of glowing sparks from the summit, then quiet.

title: Dragon
doc: A dragon circles Mt. Hood once, wings beating, with a puff of fire on the way round.

title: Time machine
doc: A car on the bridge hits 88 mph, vanishes in a flash, and leaves two trails of fire on the deck.

title: Pirates
doc: A pirate ship chases the sternwheeler up the river, firing (and missing). Often, on Sept 19.
